summary: Magnolia Terrace (48-unit multifamily, Raleigh NC) analyzed as of 2026-08-31 using the certified 2026-08-31 rent roll (the 2026-06-30 archive is stale and excluded). Physical occupancy is 44 of 48 units (0.9167) and 37,220 of 40,800 SF (0.9123); the manager's 45-of-48 headline improperly counts one pending, unpossessed suite. Suite 001 in-place rent is $1,850/mo after the signed 2026-07-20 amendment (+$350), giving $894,600 of annual in-place rent on occupied suites. Underwriting per instructions uses all-suite scheduled rent of $81,200/mo x 12 = $974,400 GPR (pre-amendment), 5% economic loss and $350/unit other income for EGI of $942,480; expenses of $301,106 (tax $102,312, insurance $34,104, other $136,416, 3% management $28,274) give NOI before reserves of $641,374 and NCF of $626,974 after $300/unit reserves. At a 5.75% cap rate value is $11,154,323. Sizing at 65% LTV ($7,250,310), 1.25x DSCR on NCF at 6.25% / 30-yr amort ($6,788,545) and 9% NCF debt yield ($6,966,373) gives a maximum loan of $6,788,545 (DSCR binding). After 1% origination ($67,885), $45,000 closing costs and the $4,200,000 payoff, net cash-out is $2,475,660 - no refinance shortfall. Deliverables created: artifacts/underwriting-v1.xlsx (Rent Roll, Underwriting, Debt, Sensitivity, Sources; live formulas, sensitivity grid, source register) and artifacts/memorandum-v2.pdf (6-page investment/sales OM). No photos, asking price, market comps or sponsor history exist in the packet; these are labeled unknown.
qualifications: Prescribed underwriting gross potential rent is a stabilized assumption using all 48 suites' scheduled rent before the Suite 001 amendment (underwriting-instructions.pdf p.1); it is not the current contractual in-place rent, which is $894,600 on 44 occupied suites and reflects the amendment.
The manager's 45-of-48 leased headline includes one pending suite that has not taken possession; occupancy statistics here use certified detail (44 active), per manager-cover.pdf p.1.
The 2026-06-30 archive rent roll conflicts with the certified 2026-08-31 roll (lower rents). The conflict is resolved by document date in favor of the certified roll; it is not left unresolved.

Historical T12 NOI ($604,128, cash basis, before management fee and reserves), underwritten NOI before reserves ($641,374) and underwritten NCF ($626,974) are different definitions and are not comparable without the stated bridge.

Loan is sized on the amortizing payment at the greater of note rate (6.2500%) and floor (6.0000%) even though the first 24 months are interest-only; actual early-period cash debt service would be lower.
No asking price, photographs, market sale/rent comparables, sponsor history, capital budget, or tax/insurance renewal quotes are supplied; these are explicitly unknown, not zero.

Legal, environmental, property condition and title reviews are incomplete (diligence-status.pdf p.1). These are routine pending items; no defect, contamination, litigation or fraud finding is asserted.
The $2,000,000 insurance figure is a general liability aggregate coverage limit, distinct from the $34,104 annual insurance expense.
Capitalization value is an income-approach indication from prescribed assumptions only, uncorroborated by market comparables.
